verdict.rationale: Sentry's own Seer agent is described as automatically root-causing issues and fixing them when they hit production. Seer's root cause analysis can also be sent straight to connected coding agents (e.g. Cursor Cloud Agents) for automated fix generation and pull request creation, which points to background agentic automation. However, the evidence does not show how users configure these automations or that they run unattended end-to-end, and Seer requires a separate subscription. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation triggers/rules for Seer, evidence of fully unattended background runs, hands-on or independent corroboration.
